definitions.gloss: to notice, to become aware of
definitions.explanation: To perceive something one hadn't noticed before.
To become conscious of a fact or situation.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}いに{気付|きづ}いた。
{誰|だれ}も{気付|きづ}かなかった。
{大切|たいせつ}さに{気付|きづ}く。

notes:
{気付|きづ}く means to notice or realize.

PATTERN:
- Xに{気付|きづ}く: to notice X

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {気付|きづ}く: to notice (きづく)
- {築|きず}く: to build (きずく)

RELATED:
- {気|き}がつく: to notice (alternative form)
- {気付|きづ}き: realization
